Vanessa / Marissa / Ben —

Attached is a proposed commercial construct (spreadsheet): sla-pricing-grid.xlsx. Key props:

1) Scaled credit bands (example):
   - Standard (99.9%): 5% monthly credit for single P1 > 30m; up to 25% cap for repeated incidents.
   - Enhanced (99.95%): 10% monthly credit for single P1 > 20m; 30% cap.
   - Premium (99.99%): 20% monthly credit for single P1 > 10m; 50% cap + rolling escalation SLA.

2) Incident vs aggregate: Credits calculated on monthly aggregate but thresholded so single long incidents hit the per-incident floor. This avoids disproportionate payouts for long maintenance windows that are pre-announced.

3) Escalation staffing: For Premium, we propose a named escalation engineer during business hours with on-call bridge coverage 24/7 via our rotational reserve. For pilots, we can offer a dedicated weekly office hour + guaranteed <2h callback for P1.

4) Commercial incentives: 10% contract term discount for an annual commit; pilot (3 months) gets a 20% onboarding credit and waived setup fee. Commit + annual prepay -> additional 5% credit.

I left optional fields open on pricing sheet so we can tailor to BrightCart traffic bands.

Attachment: sla-pricing-grid.xlsx
